title: An unmapped Shop supplies item credits ShopView Review
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure the Internal Work Orders setting is on in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Make sure the test location is connected to QuickBooks Online, with Inventory Asset and Cost of Parts mapped on its ShopView Accounts page, and that AccountingHub is not enabled.
  • Have access to the QuickBooks Online company of the test location, so its journal entries can be read.
  • Make sure the General Internal category is mapped to an expense account, account X, at the test location.
  • Make sure Require Review Before Completion is off in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Make sure the Shop supplies item has no income account mapped.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, flagged as an Internal customer.
  • Have a new internal work order for this test, work order 1, for internal customer A, in status Complete, whose Shop supplies amount is $15.00.
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1.
  2. Click Close Work Order in the work order header.
  3. Click Close Work Order in the confirmation.
  4. In QuickBooks Online, open the journal entries for work order 1's number.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 opens.

Step 2:

  • The Close confirmation opens.

Step 3:

  • The work order shows the status Closed.

Step 4:

  • The shop supplies entry debits account X $15.00 and credits the ShopView Review account $15.00.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Internal Work Orders (PRD)", Confluence 942243841, version 1.0 final (9 Nov 2026, Milos Vasic), read 12 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11665, story SV-11764 (Story 7, QuickBooks Online sync), story SV-11767 (Story 10, Shop supplies on internal and no-charge work orders)

  • S7-R4a: “At Close, when the work order's shop supplies amount is above $0.00, ShopView sends one journal entry dated the posting date: debit the work order's mapped expense account (the expense account of the work order's category), credit the income account of the existing "Shop supplies" item (Products And Services) (the account the shop supplies line of a billable invoice credits today), for that amount, memo with the work order number and "Shop supplies". If the Shop supplies item is not mapped or its income account is missing, the credit posts to ShopView Review (S7-N2).”
  • S10-N2: “If the Shop supplies item is not mapped in QuickBooks, the credit posts to the ShopView Review account as any unmapped account does; if its income account was deleted or made inactive, the entry fails into QB Unexported as every other row's does (S7-N2); in AccountingHub an empty Shop supplies expense row holds the event (S8-N2).”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
